in_marathi.name: Meenakshii
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of Love and War
in_marathi.long_meaning: Meenakshii हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Meenakshi is a form of Goddess Parvati, the consort of Lord Shiva. Her name is derived from the words 'meena' (fish) and 'akshi' (eye). She is believed to have the power to bestow her devotees with love, wisdom, and wealth. In Hindu mythology, she is also known as the 'War Goddess' for her fierce and unyielding nature.
